title: Global sections on scheme modules is additive and left exact
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The global-sections functor $\Gamma(X,-):\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Ab}$, $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F(X)$, is additive and preserves kernels; hence it is left exact in the sense of [def-sp-left-exact-additive].

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma Tag 01EZ (lemma-before-Leray), proof setup for $\Gamma(Y,-)$

proof.text: By the definition of the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], this category is abelian and kernels of module morphisms are computed sectionwise. Thus for every morphism $u:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$, the kernel module $\ker(u)$ has sections $\ker(u)(X)=\ker(\mathcal F(X)\to\mathcal G(X))$.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma Tag 01EZ (lemma-before-Leray), proof setup for $\Gamma(Y,-)$

proof.text: Evaluating at $X$ therefore carries the kernel of every module morphism to the kernel of the induced homomorphism of abelian groups. Hence $\Gamma(X,-)$ preserves kernels.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma Tag 01EZ (lemma-before-Leray), proof setup for $\Gamma(Y,-)$

proof.text: The section map of a module morphism is a homomorphism of abelian groups [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and finite products in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ are computed sectionwise, evaluation at $X$ carrying them to the products of the abelian groups of sections [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-limits-sectionwise]. Thus evaluation at $X$, namely $\Gamma(X,-)$, preserves finite products, i.e. is additive. Combining additivity with kernel preservation gives left exactness by the definition [def-sp-left-exact-additive].
